title: Build bounded Native KaTeX compositor conformance

sourceRefs.summary: Approved objective, coverage model, budgets, slice order, preservation boundary, rollback units, and checkpoint.

verificationRecords.notes: Validated 1,035 nodes and 23,683 events after cutover setup; complete v2 contract is active, malformed v1 is superseded, carrier run and action are deferred, and the return condition is explicit.
Approved proposal correction and generated control-plane records have no whitespace errors; protected economics and unrelated untracked files remain unstaged.
Three deterministic baseline assertions freeze canonical 2 as continuous, italic x as a symmetric 13.828125px source/material/target seam regression, and =4 as stationary.
Application, Node, test, Svelte, and domain TypeScript projects accept the test-only baseline fixture and command.
Inventory confirms the baseline command remains green and identifies the sole missing proof seam: browser-realized material ink correlated with existing native endpoint paint authority.
Six checks freeze baseline evidence plus hard canary/promotion/browser, five-sample, one-page, one-worker, zero-routine-screenshot, and zero-unseeded-fuzz budgets in 0.43 seconds.
Nine checks pass in 0.44 seconds; the test-only descriptor enforces shape/paint/ownership/baseline consistency, immutability, non-empty fixtures, and unique registry IDs.

Ten checks pass; structural risk tags are exhaustive, required by shape class, unique, immutable, and canonically ordered, with italic x represented as glyph plus font-style risk rather than a special-case shape.

Fourteen checks pass in 0.63 seconds; generic data-driven pairwise selection covers all five-factor pairs, includes the named three-way override, is deterministic, and fails closed when the scenario cap is insufficient.
Stable JSON-safe coverage manifest explains every selected scenario, its first-covered pairs, and any explicit three-way risk override; 16 tests pass.

Nineteen checks pass; the test-only observer routes atomic text to measured ink, rules and compounds to subtree paint, measures baseline and effective opacity, names stage-layout coordinates, and fails closed without realized paint.

Twenty-one checks pass; a strict five-slot seam trace now preserves one semantic shape through native-source, material, and native-target owners with monotonically ordered stage-realized observations and lifecycle/font revisions.

Twenty-four checks pass; continuity laws compare actual ink translation, baseline or top anchors, symmetric scale, active-owner visibility, and inactive-owner suppression at both handoff seams using explicit shared thresholds.
Twenty-six checks pass; deterministic JSON diagnostics report environment revisions, five realized samples, seam failure classes, and exact translation/scale metrics without screenshots.

One Chromium worker, one reusable page, two scenarios, and five semantic samples per transition captured actual text ink, baseline, and all owner opacities in 14.6 seconds with no screenshots or page errors.
Full typecheck and 1,431-module production build passed; source and emitted HTML/JS/CSS/maps contain none of five test-only conformance schema, trace, assessment, report, or registry markers.
Canonical digit 2 passes both actual-paint ownership seams with no diagnostic failures while sharing the same observer, trace, laws, page, and compositor path as italic x.

Italic x is now an executable expected regression: the same actual-paint harness classifies only vertical translation at both source-to-material and material-to-target seams, greater than 10px in symmetric directions; digit 2 remains clean.

verificationRecords.notes: Compact ten-frame 2/x overlay contact sheet generated from one reused page; architecture gates, full production build, test-only closure exclusion, and 1,035-node workspace validation pass. Awaiting the mandatory human visual decision before ncc20.
Both canonical 2 and italic x pass five realized-paint checkpoints with a 0.25px seam-translation ceiling after exact same-size glyph lineage preserves one material clone.
All five carrier browser scenarios pass, including direct seek, reverse, resize, reduced motion, and add-zero ownership.
Regenerated the compact ten-frame 2/x review sheet for the mandatory human checkpoint.
Full typecheck and production bundle pass after typed paint-realization authority reached source, tests, and the performance harness.
Browser history restores exact same-document playhead state while frame-rate seeks emit only bounded coarse URL projections.

Thirty deterministic checks pass; the atomic cohort names seven renderable representatives for digit, italic, descender, Greek, operator, relation, and punctuation while remaining below the 24-scenario canary ceiling.
The new atomic registry remains test-only and absent from production source and emitted artifacts.

Thirty-four checks pass; two script-position and four explicit font-style representatives extend the shared registry to 13 shapes while preserving atomic identities and remaining below the 24-scenario canary ceiling.
Script and style descriptors remain development-only and absent from production closure.

Thirty-seven checks pass; six renderable structured representatives extend the shared registry to 19 shapes while naming fraction/root subtree paint, standalone rule paint, accent ownership, and fixed/stretchy delimiter risks below the 24-scenario canary ceiling.
Structured descriptors and their tests remain development-only and absent from production closure.

Forty-one checks pass; five typed context mutations preserve one carrier and a generic five-factor pairwise canary covers every pair plus the explicit script/math-style/compound risk in 23 scenarios, within the 24-scenario ceiling.
The production closure now rejects the context-mutation registry marker; source and emitted artifacts remain clean across six forbidden conformance markers.

Forty-four checks pass; exactly two diagnostic 2x2 matrix fixtures distinguish whole compound ownership from four persistent heterogeneous cell identities, render through KaTeX, and keep the shared registry at 21 shapes below the canary ceiling.
The production closure rejects the matrix-fixture marker; source and emitted artifacts remain clean across seven forbidden conformance markers.

Forty-seven checks pass; large-operator, cases, and alignment representatives fill the fast registry at exactly 24 shapes, while one nested vertical-list/delimiter/multirow risk fixture is covered by a deterministic 20-scenario promotion plan below the 96-scenario ceiling.
The production closure rejects the compound-risk fixture marker; source and emitted artifacts remain clean across eight forbidden conformance markers.

expectedLearning: Determine whether feature-class coverage plus actual-paint seam observation can prevent Native KaTeX carrier discontinuities without glyph-specific branches or production cost.
allowedWork: Execute only the approved Native KaTeX compositor-conformance proposal through its typed run contract.
disallowedWork: Do not resume carrier promotion until conformance closes; do not ship test infrastructure or broaden into aesthetics, lessons, layouts, or other renderers.
